title: CIS Control 8.9 as an implemented requirement carrying an audit and a remediation script, the Rules shape
content:
{
  "uuid": "756db305-9b42-5bfd-a650-55745ec620eb",
  "control-id": "cisc-008.009",
  "description": "6.1.3.3 Ensure journald is configured to send logs to rsyslog",
  "automation-scripts": [
    {
      "uuid": "76b00623-6131-5b93-a4df-ccc59c9107ad",
      "benchmark-rule-id": "6.1.3.3",
      "script-type": "audit",
      "language": "bash",
      "applicable-profiles": [
        "Level 1 - Server",
        "Level 2 - Server",
        "Level 1 - Workstation",
        "Level 2 - Workstation"
      ],
      "evaluation-criteria": {
        "method": "stdout-regex",
        "pass-condition": "^\\*\\* PASS \\*\\*$",
        "fail-condition": "^\\*\\* FAIL \\*\\*$"
      },
      "payload": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n\n{\n   a_output=() a_output2=() l_analyze_cmd=\"$(readlink -f /bin/systemd-analyze)\" l_systemd_config_file=\"systemd/journald.conf\"\n   a_parameters=(\"ForwardToSyslog=yes\")\n   f_config_file_parameter_chk()\n   {\n      l_used_parameter_setting=\"\"\n      while IFS= read -r l_file; do\n         l_file=\"$(tr -d '# ' <<< \"$l_file\")\"\n         l_used_parameter_setting=\"$(grep -PHs -- '^\\h*'\"$l_parameter_name\"'\\b' \"$l_file\" | tail -n 1)\"\n         [ -n \"$l_used_parameter_setting\" ] && break [truncated]"
    },
    {
      "uuid": "6e1a2b80-caf7-5a42-9dc7-a554bb7315bb",
      "benchmark-rule-id": "6.1.3.3",
      "script-type": "remediation",
      "language": "bash",
      "applicable-profiles": [
        "Level 1 - Server",
        "Level 2 - Server",
        "Level 1 - Workstation",
        "Level 2 - Workstation"
      ],
      "payload": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n\n{\n   a_settings=(\"ForwardToSyslog=yes\")\n   [ ! -d /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/ ] && mkdir /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/\n   if grep -Psq -- '^\\h*\\[Journal\\]' /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/60-journald.conf; then\n      printf '%s\\n' \"\" \"${a_settings[@]}\" >> /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/60-journald.conf\n   else\n      printf '%s\\n' \"\" \"[Journal]\" \"${a_settings[@]}\" >> /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/60-journald.conf\n   fi\n}\n"
    }
  ],
  "props": "..."
}
